facts.note: Transcript states that when the temple struck nine, Aurèle had each of them show their watches, and that the speaker's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell.

Transcript states piquet in the salon until the speaker's watch showed a quarter to eleven, then he went to the hall for his cigar case, and that Madame began playing the piano as he went out and stopped when he came back.
Transcript gives the ten strike during the game and the salon clock showing five minutes to ten, but omits that the speaker remarked on it to Madame.

added.quote: We went on with the cards. The temple struck ten while we were still at them.
added.why: The ten o'clock strike is placed after the hall trip and after the piano stopped and play resumed, an order between the ten strike and the piano/hall events that the fact sheet does not give.
